title: Two-phase signing
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 6.2 Key Management; W3C Web Cryptography API; QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1.

statements.label: Two-phase signing
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL offer a two-phase flow: prepare returns the exact bytes to sign (the Sig_structure), the caller signs them by any means, including asynchronous ones such as WebCrypto or a remote KMS, and finish assembles the certificate. For ES256, finish SHALL accept r||s or DER and SHALL always emit r||s.

sources.quote: Converting between the two is the single most common interoperability bug in HCERT implementations.
